comments.P: Object-left/type-right and hover-fact are fine portfolio defaults. Edition-mark signature is name-only; little island/letterpress craft beyond palette nouns. Honest diagram-led assets until plates exist.
comments.Q: Portfolio Grid + Neo Brutalism + Space Grotesk + system pink/cyan fights chalk/harbour/coral and curator tone. Hard black borders read agency-brutal, not coastal letterpress. Thin pack craft.
comments.R: Ferry departure board is the standout: editions as rows, paper/size/press as columns, coral lamp on active, enquire as destination. Split-flap grammar fits motion-3. Risk of generic transit UI if facts lag is named and mitigated.
comments.S: Locked chase + job-ticket rail + coral registration-cross UI is print-native end-to-end. Three type roles, five tokens, honest Ferry Board pending plate. Highest build clarity among the characterful set.
comments.T: Correct journey and asset honesty with registration-mark motif, but less singular than R/S—reads as a strong variance-locked portfolio plan rather than a memorable studio instrument. Safest generic-good option.
